{"id":1769269985,"question_id":3872,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"10 months, 1 week","timestamp":1757768302,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"0 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1769269985/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Find Most Frequent Vowel and Consonant","memory":"9.8 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    int maxFreqSum(string s) {\n        unordered_map<char,int>mp;\n\n        for(auto ch: s)\n        {\n            mp[ch]++;\n        }\n\n        int vowel_maxfreq = 0;\n        int consonant_maxfreq = 0;\n\n        for(auto it : mp)\n        {\n            if(it.first == 'a' || it.first == 'e' ||it.first == 'i' ||it.first == 'o' ||it.first == 'u')\n            vowel_maxfreq = max(vowel_maxfreq , it.second);\n\n            else\n            consonant_maxfreq = max(consonant_maxfreq , it.second);\n        }\n    return vowel_maxfreq + consonant_maxfreq;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"find-most-frequent-vowel-and-consonant","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":795}
